description: Rate updates on WhatsApp, catalogue sync and WhatsApp orders (HLD-005).

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Scan rate changes and publish them on WhatsApp.

fields.label: Publish after quiet minutes
fields.description: A Rate Update publishes this long after its last change (0 = only by Publish now).

fields.label: Rate Update Template
fields.description: Marketing template: IMAGE header (the rate card); body with {{date}}, {{summary}} and {{more}} (or 3 positional) that does not end with a variable, e.g. "Rates updated {{date}}: {{summary}}, {{more}}. Tap a button below."; 3 Quick Reply buttons in this order: View & Order, Full Catalogue, Ask Best Price.

fields.label: Brand
fields.description: Used when an item has no brand (Meta requires one of brand / GTIN / MPN).

fields.label: Product page URL
fields.description: Meta requires a product page on your domain, e.g. https://example.com/products/{item_code}

fields.label: Wait after catalogue sync (s)
fields.description: Meta reviews catalogue changes; give it this long before the broadcast goes out.

fields.label: Full Catalogue reply
fields.default: Here is our full catalogue — add items to your cart and send the order.

fields.label: View & Order reply
fields.default: Today's changed rates — tap to view, add to cart and send your order.

fields.label: Ask Best Price reply (until the request form is set up)
fields.default: Tell us the item and quantity you need — our sales team will reply with our best price.

fields.label: Order price list when the customer has none
Order received reply
fields.default: Thank you — order {order} received. Our team will confirm rates and delivery shortly.

fields.label: Request Form (WhatsApp Flow)
fields.description: Published Flow. Its first screen receives `items` (id, title, description) and returns item, qty and optionally uom, target_rate, note.

fields.label: Offer Template (outside 24 h)
fields.description: Used only when the 24-hour window has closed. Named variables {{request}} {{item}} {{qty}} {{rate}} {{list_rate}} {{offer}} {{valid_till}} (use any), or positional {{1}}=request {{2}}=item {{3}}=offer {{4}}=valid till; 3 Quick Replies: Accept, Decline, Talk to sales.

fields.label: Raven channel id
fields.description: The channel's id (its name in Raven Channel, e.g. <workspace>-sales-rate-requests) — not the display name.

fields.label: Raven bot
fields.description: Raven Bot name that posts the requests.

fields.label: Max discount without approval (%)
fields.description: Offers deeper than this below list wait for an approver. 0 = every offer needs approval; offers without a list rate always do.

name: Excom Commerce Settings
